name: exists_smodEq
statement: PowerBasis A B) (b : B) : ∃ a, SModEq (Ideal.span ({pb.gen})) b (algebraMap A B a)

name: dim_le_natDegree_of_root
statement: PowerBasis A S) {p : A[X]} (ne_zero : p ≠ 0) (root : aeval pb.gen p = 0) : pb.dim ≤ p.natDegree

name: constr_pow_aeval
statement: PowerBasis A S) {y : S'} (hy : aeval y (minpoly A pb.gen) = 0) (f : A[X]) : pb.basis.constr A (fun i => y ^ (i : ℕ)) (aeval pb.gen f) = aeval y f

name: IsIntegral.mem_span_pow
statement: S} (hx : IsIntegral R x) (hy : ∃ f : R[X], y = aeval x f) : y ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range fun i : Fin (minpoly R x).natDegree => x ^ (i : ℕ))
